scope: E2.2: read surfaces needed by E4a and E3; no map writes

changes.affected: entries now carry api/constraint/refs; top level carries state/snapshot_match/map_digest/binding
changes.map_digest: check_map/summarize/maintain/entry_report expose the sha256 of the map bytes
changes.entry_report: absent returns state=absent and present=false instead of a storage error; needs_snapshot returns a state object
changes.maintain: needs_snapshot returns a state object with command=maintain instead of failing
changes.markdown: maintain uses map_snapshot/current_snapshot and its own entries block; no fake snapshot/0-token line

why: brief(recipe=change) could not show the Entry's S constraint, so E4a's B arm had no way to see the map-only obligation before editing.
E3's --expected-hash had no map digest to consume.
A green map check could hide an absent map behind a storage error, and maintain --markdown reported none/0 tokens for a valid map.

manual_end_to_end.map_maintain_markdown: state ok; 7 total/7 unchanged; map digest and freshness printed
manual_end_to_end.brief_change_before_edit: cognition_map.affected is empty because no code has changed yet; map_digest and state=ok are visible
manual_end_to_end.map_entry_inspect: returns the pricing Entry with S and the invoice/analytics refs

limitations: affected still only lists entries for files already changed; before the first edit, the B arm must inspect the target file's Entry
map_digest is over exact bytes; line-ending normalization is not applied
E4a has not been run; Claude Code is installed but not authenticated in this environment
